transcript_full: Did you know? Trees get periods too. Just kidding. Welcome to an episode of Treat It. This unique tree is found in South Africa and it is known as the Bloodwood Tree. It is named Bloodwood Tree because it releases a red dark sap which also heals the tree when it has an infection, just like us humans. Why is so special about this tree you may ask? It has medicinal benefits which include the power to heal diseases such as ringworms, eye problems, stomach aches, malaria and serious injuries. We need this tree, so treat it with care.
